text:
noah.g: morning — onboarding snag. got my MacBook Pro (M2, serial NX2026NOAH). Company Portal shows "Awaiting management" and Disk Utility says encryption: Off. when I try to run Docker I get "bad CPU type in executable". also Homebrew install prompts for admin. remote from home, VPN connected but still pending. who can help re-enroll or temp admin?
enroll-bot: device NX2026NOAH detected, enrollment_state=pending. Self-enroll: https://idp.redwood.example.com/self-enroll. If using corp-vpn ensure split-tunnel allows MDM endpoints.
noah.g: i thought vpn would handle it but maybe split-tunnel blocks jamf. how can i check?
ivy.it: hey and welcome! run `scutil --nc list` to confirm VPN routes or try corp-secure if you can come onsite. i'll open a ticket but first paste `/usr/bin/fdesetup status` and `profiles show --type enrollment` (short lines only).
noah.g: pasted:
`FileVault is Off`
`Enrollment: Pending`
`MDM: jamf.redwood.local`
sam.sre: likely split-tunnel. ivy, can you check the DEP console and try a remote enroll push? if that fails we can grant a 6h local admin for rosetta/docker installs.
ivy.it: filing IT-5011 with serial + VPN config note. kicking remote re-enroll now. enroll-bot: re-enroll job queued id=2026-03-13-66 -> in_progress.
noah.g: quick Q: if FileVault is off now and MDM later forces it, will it prompt me to enable and store recovery in Jamf? i'm worried about losing local keychains.
ivy.it: yes you'll get a prompt to enable FileVault and Jamf will escrow the recovery key when bootstrap token is present; we'll do token rotation if needed. proceed when the dialog appears.
enroll-bot: re-enroll completed; device now shows Managed.
noah.g: it changed to Managed but fdesetup still reports Off.
ivy.it: pushing FileVault profile now and requesting bootstrap rotation. you should get a system dialog to enable FileVault under your corp account (noah.g@redwood.com).
enroll-bot: filevault_push job id=2026-03-13-67 queued -> done.
noah.g: prompt appeared, enabled FileVault, got confirmation of escrow location. `fdesetup status` now: `FileVault is On.` nice.
ivy.it: temp admin granted for 6h in IT-5011 to install Rosetta and Docker; will auto-revoke. run `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` then install Docker Desktop (Apple Silicon). post docker --version here when done.
sam.sre: also note for runbook: if corp-vpn uses split-tunnel, new-hires must either connect via corp-secure or use a full-tunnel profile for initial enrollment.
noah.g: installed rosetta and Docker, `Docker version 24.0.5` shows. Homebrew works now. thanks for the quick turnaround.
zoe-devex: welcome aboard! tagging this ticket to add a short note in the new-hires guide about split-tunnel headaches and the 6h temp-admin workflow. :wave:
